correctness.rationale: PASS. Reconstructed face partition X=Y union Z by whether both center vertices occur. The at-most-one-center part Y is contractible by attaching two cones along bases each joined to a nonempty opposite-leaf simplex; Z is the cone Delta_{u,v} * K, K the leaf subsets of size <=r-2. Their intersection is boundary Delta_{u,v} * K; homotopy pushout of two contractibles is its suspension, with augmented r=2 convention giving S1. The truncated simplex augmented homology ker(contraction epsilon on wedge^k Z[L]) equals wedge^k E integrally by splitting Z[L]=Z w plus E, free of binom(t-1,k) rank; standard simplex-skeleton homotopy gives sphere wedge including top and k=0 endpoints. Natural Mayer--Vietoris suspension gives the central swap sign and leaf exterior-power action. The determinant identity prod_C(1-(-z)^|C|)/(1+z) gives the character. Computing S_a x S_b-invariants in exterior powers of the two hook-standard blocks plus the block mean line proves only k=0/1 survive before center exchange; balanced exchange sign cancels at k=1 only. An independently written enumerator recomputed mod2 homology and signed Lefschetz traces for all 45 cases 1<=a,b<=3 and 2<=r<=t+2, including nontrivial center swaps. The finite tests corroborate, do NOT replace arbitrary-parameter argument.
